title: Slice coefficient equivalence for the fixed completed immersion model
statement: Let i:S→X be an immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion], A a Noetherian ring and I any ideal. For every U in S.ProEt there is an equivalence from the standard derived category over the completed coefficient ring on the AsSmall model slice at up(U) to the standard derived category over the actual inverse-image completed coefficient ring on U. Uniformly in every completed complex K, this equivalence identifies slice restriction of the fixed object sfbImmersionCompletedModel(K) [def-sfb-adic-immersion-completed-model] with sfbLocalRestriction(K) [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. The same equivalence identifies slice restriction of adicResidueConstantPerfect(P) [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons] with sfbLocalRestriction of sfbCompletedModel(P), for every ordinary A-complex P. No completeness, residue witness, boundedness or perfectness is assumed.

proof.text: Before localization use the additive slice module equivalence and natural comparison of the ordinary normalized inverse image with the actual module pullback. The normalization of actual derived objects is isomorphic to the exact derived functor of N_X: apply the Q-preimage isomorphisms twice and the exact derived composition comparison.

For an immersion, completedMap is invertible and the universal derived-pullback comparison is invertible on every complex. Its value on Q.objPreimage identifies sfbImmersionCompletedModel(K) with D(T_i)(D(N_X)(K)). Derive the module equivalence and its natural isomorphism. Compose the exact-functor composition isomorphisms and the actual slice representative isomorphism to obtain the first comparison for every K with the same derived equivalence eU.

Apply the natural ordinary constant-module comparison termwise to the arbitrary coefficient complex P and localize. The normalization and completed-pullback isomorphisms identify sfbImmersionCompletedModel(sfbCompletedModel(P)) with adicResidueConstantPerfect(P). Restrict this isomorphism to the slice, apply eU, and compose its inverse with the inverse first comparison at sfbCompletedModel(P).

theorem sfbImmersion_sliceComparisons
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion i]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
    ∀ U : S.ProEt, ∃ eU :
          ConstantCompletion.D
            ((ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} S) A I).over
              ((AsSmall.up : S.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, 0} S).obj U)) ≌
            (let R := (adicLisseForget S).obj
              ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
                (adicLisseCompletedRing X I))
             @DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (R.over U)) _ _
               (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)),
        (∀ K : @DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)) _ _
            (proEtaleRingModules_hasDerivedCategory X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I)),
          Nonempty (sfbLocalRestriction i (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U K ≅
          eU.functor.obj ((adicResidueRestriction.{u + 1}
            (ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} S) A I)
            ((AsSmall.up : S.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, 0} S).obj U)).obj
              (sfbImmersionCompletedModel i I K)))) ∧
        ∀ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ,
          Nonempty (eU.functor.obj ((adicResidueRestriction.{u + 1}
            (ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, 0} S) A I)
            ((AsSmall.up : S.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, 0} S).obj U)).obj
              (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, 0} S I P)) ≅
            sfbLocalRestriction i (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U (sfbCompletedModel X I P))
